newsitem.title: HONG KONG: ASIAN DEBT MARKETS - Swire Pacific snaps up HK dlrs.
newsitem.headline: ASIAN DEBT MARKETS - Swire Pacific snaps up HK dlrs.

text.p: Swire Pacific made its first foray into the Hong Kong dollar debt markets since 1994 on Tuesday with a HK$3.0 billion floating rate note issue.
HSBC Markets and NatWest Markets are arrangers and lead managers for the issue.
The two-tranche issue was launched through a special purpose vehicle and guaranteed by Swire Pacific.

Tranche A of HK$1.5 billion matures in three years and pays a coupon of 25 basis points over the three-month Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate. It was re-offered at 99.85 to give a re-offer spread of HIBOR plus 30 basis points.
With fees, banks participating at the highest level receive an all-in return of 32 basis points over HIBOR.
